items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: Banjo player. He had an ordinary $150 vega phone banjo.

ctx.x: Banjo player. He had an ordinary $150 vega phone banjo. And there was four bands. Well, I had this band here with Newly. And there was four bands. It's in a square up in Uptown, a couple of... It's in Anunciation Square. The buzzers, different clubs, they call the buzzers, different clubs, they call the buzzers, and whatnot. They had these bands. Uptown? Oh, it's ripped on this way back. The Tent Ward.
